title: Upper bound for power-row work
statement: For natural numbers $\ell,p$, let $M(\ell)$ denote the work of one binary modular multiplication, define $A(\ell,e)=\ell+e(M(\ell)+1)$, and define $P_\ell(0)=0$ and $P_\ell(p+1)=P_\ell(p)+A(\ell,p+1)+\ell+1$. Then $P_\ell(p)\le p\bigl(2\ell+p(M(\ell)+1)+1\bigr)$.
